name: Valakut Fireboar — "switch its power and toughness" switches the Fireboar's own
notes: Sweep singleton (2026-10-07). "Whenever this creature attacks, switch its power and toughness until end of turn" produced nothing: "its" became "that creature's", which no parser reads. In a fired trigger whose condition names the source, "switch its" now reads "switch this creature's". The 1/7 Fireboar is 7/1.
